scenarios.recipe: Run two fresh processes with --steps 16 on the same backend; the second uses --reference {first-output} to replay exact teacher-forced histories.
assertions: metrics.complete is true and case histories/token counts match.
Every logit is finite; compare identical forced token history, max absolute error, cosine and top-token margins.
Record first divergent case/step/token and full rows; autoregressive text equality is not enough.
This is within-backend consistency. An independent oracle or cross-backend accuracy claim requires a separate controlled reference.
requirements: Built ForcedLogitProbe
Reference generated with same model hash and case inputs

scenarios.recipe: Run short-short, long-long, short-long-short and long-short orders with 32/512 prompt-token lengths and 32 teacher-forced decode steps. Compare each reused-model ResetKVCache case with a fresh-process reference.
assertions: All complete markers true; exact prompt lengths and teacher-forced histories match their reference.
Finite logits at every step; declared max-absolute/relative or cosine tolerance gates apply independently of argmax.
Report first changed row/token and preceding case/length; include per-step top-k/selected token, model/backend hashes and reset boundary.
Sequence agreement is consistency evidence only; it does not identify a root cause or establish independent numerical accuracy.
requirements: Built sequence-capable ForcedLogitProbe
Fresh process references from identical model/backend and generated fixed histories

scenarios.recipe: POST /v1/chat/completions with fixed seed, greedy sampler and arithmetic fixture
assertions: Expected answer, assistant role, nonempty choices, model identity and bounded token usage.

scenarios.recipe: POST /v1/chat/completions stream=true with same fixed input as nonstream
assertions: Valid SSE JSON chunks, exactly one terminal [DONE], nonempty assistant delta and expected reconstructed answer.

scenarios.recipe: Close an in-flight streaming request, then perform a bounded follow-up request
assertions: Stream starts before cancellation; owned server stays healthy and follow-up completes; no stale text crosses requests.

scenarios.recipe: Repeat fixed conversations, reset owned session, repeat prompt
assertions: No cross-session secret leakage; after reset same seeded answer; retained-cache behavior requires backend-specific trace evidence.
